# Low-proliferation zones

Here we characterize regions of low cancer cell profliferation.


```{r eval = TRUE}
#| label: loading preamble
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
source("./preamble.R")
```

## Assign proliferation scores
We start by assigning proliferation scores to each cell, using Seurat's cell cycle scoring method.

```{r}
#| label: predict_cell_cycle
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: true
#| eval: false

# if there's no seurat object, read it in
if (!("seu.obj" %in% ls())){
  seu.obj <- readRDS(results_list$seurat_file_postCellTyping)
}

# Predict cell cycle
s_genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m_genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes
seu.obj <- CellCycleScoring(seu.obj, s.features = s_genes, g2m.features = g2m_genes)

# Extract predictions by cell
cell_cycle_predictions <- seu.obj@meta.data$Phase
names(cell_cycle_predictions) <- seu.obj@meta.data$cell_ID

# Save predictions
saveRDS(cell_cycle_predictions, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/cell_cycle_predictions.rds"))

```

Next, we load in basic data.

```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
library(data.table) 
library(InSituCor)
library(scales)
library(pheatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(smiDE)
library(fgsea)  
library(dplyr)
library(alphahull)
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)

source("patchDE utils.R")

#### load data ------------------------------

raw <- Matrix::t(readRDS(paste0(analysis_dir, "/Robjects/raw_exp_mat.rds")))
xy <- readRDS(paste0(analysis_dir, "/Robjects/xy.rds"))
clustdf <- readRDS(paste0(analysis_dir, "/Robjects/cell_types.rds"))
clust <- clustdf$major_cell_type
iscancer <- clust == "Tumor"
cellcycle <- readRDS(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/cell_cycle_predictions.rds"))
cellcyclecanceronly <- replace(cellcycle, !iscancer, "notcancer")
niches <- readRDS(paste0(analysis_dir, "/niches/Data/novae_domains_9_assignments.rds"))
seu <- readRDS(paste0(analysis_dir, "/Robjects/seurat_object_postCellTyping.rds"))
annot <- seu@meta.data
stopifnot(identical(annot$cell_ID, rownames(raw)))
rm(seu)
annot$celltype <- clust

# rotated xy:
xy21 <- xy[, 2:1]
xy21[, 2] <- mean(xy21[, 2]) - xy21[, 2]
```

Now we'll partition the tissue into regions of high/low tumor proliferation:

```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
# there are islands of G1 phase, otherwise cancer cells are mostly G2/M/S... what explains the islands where it's failing to proliferate?
if (!file.exists(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/neighbors100.RDS"))) {
  neighbors100 <- InSituCor:::nearestNeighborGraph(x = xy[, 1], y = xy[, 2], N = 100)
  saveRDS(neighbors100, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/neighbors100.RDS"))
} else {
  neighbors100 <- readRDS(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/neighbors100.RDS"))
}

if (!file.exists(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/neighborhoodcelltypes.RDS"))) {
  # neighbor counts of tumor cells in each cell cycle phase
  nphase <- InSituCor:::neighbor_tabulate(cellcyclecanceronly, neighbors100) 
  # neighbor counts of cell types:
  neighborhoodcelltypes <- InSituCor:::neighbor_tabulate(clust, neighbors100) 
  saveRDS(nphase, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/nphase.RDS"))
  saveRDS(neighborhoodcelltypes, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/neighborhoodcelltypes.RDS"))
} else {
  nphase <- readRDS(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/nphase.RDS"))
  neighborhoodcelltypes <- readRDS(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/neighborhoodcelltypes.RDS"))
}
rm(neighbors100)

# rate of proliferating cancer cells in neighborhood:
prop_g2ms <- rowSums(nphase[, c("G2M", "S")]) / rowSums(nphase[, c("G1", "G2M", "S")])
prop_g2ms[is.na(prop_g2ms)] <- 0
# number of cancer cells in neighborhood:
ncancer_all <- rowSums(nphase[, c("G1", "G2M", "S")])
ncancer_cycling <- rowSums(nphase[, c("G2M", "S")])
ncancer_resting <- nphase[, "G1"]


#### What characterizes cancer cells in highly proliferative regions? -------------

# classify cancer cells as occupying proliferative/quiescent regions:
use <- (clust == "Tumor") & (ncancer_all >= 20) 
hist(prop_g2ms[use], breaks = 25)
abline(v = 0.5, col = 2)
prolifcat <- c("quiescent", "proliferative")[1 + (prop_g2ms > 0.5)]

## summarize tumor proliferation context:
table(prolifcat[iscancer]) / sum(table(prolifcat[iscancer]))

# polygons around quiescent areas:
dbuse <- (prolifcat == "quiescent") & (iscancer)
db <- dbscan::dbscan(xy[dbuse, ], eps = 0.05, minPts = 20)
if (!file.exists(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/qpolys.RDS"))) {
  qpolys <- list()
  for (i in setdiff(unique(db$cluster), 0)) {
    if (i %% 10 == 0){print(i)}
    inds <- which(dbuse)[db$cluster == i]
    qpolys[[as.character(i)]] <- alphahull::ahull(xy21[inds, ], alpha = 0.04)

    arcs <- qpolys[[as.character(i)]]$arcs
    arcs_clean <- arcs[(arcs[, "r"] > 0) & (arcs[, "end1"] != arcs[, "end2"]), ]
    qpolys[[as.character(i)]]$arcs <- arcs_clean
  }
  saveRDS(qpolys, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/qpolys.RDS"))
} else {
  qpolys <- readRDS(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/qpolys.RDS"))
}

# show the cell type results and the classification:
inds <- clust == "Tumor"
cccols <- c("G1" = "cornflowerblue", "G2M" = scales::alpha("orange", 0.5), "S" = scales::alpha("firebrick1", 0.5))
png(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Plots/cellcycle - whole tissue.png"), width =8, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plot(xy21[inds, ], pch = 16, cex = 0.1, asp = 1, col = cccols[cellcycle[inds]])
lines(c(11,12), c(3,3))
text(11.5, 3.2, "1 mm")
for (i in 1:length(qpolys)) {
  plot(qpolys[[i]], add = TRUE, wpoints = F, col = "black")
}
dev.off()
svg(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Plots/cellcycle color legend.svg"), width = .7, height = .8)
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
frame()
legend("center", pch = 16, col = cccols, legend = names(cccols))
dev.off()

png(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Plots/cellcycle - zoomed.png"), width = 3, height = 3, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plot(xy21[inds, ], pch = 16, cex = 0.25, asp = 1, col = cccols[cellcycle[inds]],
     xlim = c(4.3,6.5), ylim = c(-0.2, 1.8))
lines(c(5.4,6.4), c(1.35,1.35))
text(5.85, 1.4, "1 mm")
for (i in 1:length(qpolys)) {
  plot(qpolys[[i]], add = TRUE, wpoints = F, col = "black")
}
dev.off()
```


Now we run the PatchDE algorithm to partition the tissue into patches to be analyzed separately:

```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
use <- ((clust == "Tumor") & (ncancer_all >= 20)) & (cellcycle == "G1")
Xall <- model.matrix(lm(rnorm(length(prolifcat)) ~ prolifcat))

# run it:
if (!file.exists(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/patchDE.RDS"))) {
  set.seed(0)
  res <- getPatches(xy = xy[use, 2:1], 
                    X = Xall[use, 2], 
                    npatches = 100,
                    bitesize = 0.1,
                    maxradius = 5,
                    roundness = 0.25,
                    initwithhotspots = TRUE,
                    n_iters = 10,
                    alpha = 0.5,
                    effectivezerodist = 0.025,
                    plotprogress = TRUE) 
    
  saveRDS(res, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/patchDE.RDS"))
} else {
  res <- readRDS(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/patchDE.RDS"))
}

barplot(table(prolifcat[use], res[use])[2:1, ], ylim = c(0,100))

polys <- getPatchHulls(xy21[use, ], patch = res, alpha = 0.3) 

png(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Plots/patchDE bins2.png"), width =8, height = 5, units = "in", res = 300)
par(mar = c(0,0,0,0))
plot(xy21[use, ], pch = 16, cex = 0.2, asp = 1,
     col = c("wheat", "darkblue")[as.numeric(as.factor(prolifcat[use]))])
for (i in 1:length(polys)) {
  if (!is.null(polys[[i]])) {
    plot(polys[[i]], add = TRUE, wpoints = F)#, col = "black")  
  }
}
dev.off()
```

```{r echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE, out.width = "85%"}
knitr::include_graphics(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Plots/patchDE bins2.png"))
```


Now we lay the groundwork for DE:

```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
if (!file.exists(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/overlap_metrics.rds"))) {
  overlap_metrics <-
    smiDE::contamination_ratio_metric(assay_matrix = Matrix::t(raw),
                                      metadata = annot,
                                      cluster_col = "celltype",
                                      radius = 0.05,
                                      sdimx_col = "x_slide_mm",
                                      sdimy_col = "y_slide_mm"
    )
  # Save overlap metrics
  saveRDS(overlap_metrics, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/overlap_metrics.rds"))
} else {
  overlap_metrics <- readRDS(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/overlap_metrics.rds"))
}

## set up DE:
scaling_factors <- Matrix::rowSums(raw)
norm <- Matrix::Diagonal(x = scaling_factors^-1) %*% raw * mean(scaling_factors)

# which genes to keep: low overlap, not low mean
analysis_genes <- overlap_metrics[celltype == "Tumor" & (ratio <= 1)]$target
length(analysis_genes)
norm <- norm[, analysis_genes]

# scale norm:
genefactors <- pmax(Matrix::colMeans(norm), 0.1)
genefactors <- genefactors / mean(genefactors)
norm.s <- norm %*% Matrix::Diagonal(x = 1 / genefactors)
colnames(norm.s) <- colnames(norm)
```

Now we run DE over each patch:

```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
if (!file.exists(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/patchDEresults.RDS"))) {
  deres <- patchDE(y = norm.s[use, ], df = data.frame(prolifcat = prolifcat[use]), patch = res)
  saveRDS(deres, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/patchDEresults.RDS"))
} else {
  deres <- readRDS(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/patchDEresults.RDS"))
}


# replace NA results - arising from all-0 expression - with 0s:
ps <- replace(deres$prolifcatquiescent$pvals, is.na(deres$prolifcatquiescent$pvals), 1)
ests <- replace(deres$prolifcatquiescent$ests, is.na(deres$prolifcatquiescent$pvals), 0)
ses <- replace(deres$prolifcatquiescent$ses, is.na(deres$prolifcatquiescent$pvals), 1e6)

# write supplementary table of DE results:
out <- data.table(gene = rep(rownames(ps), ncol(ps)),
                  patch = rep(colnames(ps), each = nrow(ps)),
                  estimate = as.vector(ests),
                  pvalue = as.vector(ps),
                  se = as.vector(ses))
write.csv(out, file = paste0(prolif_dir, "/Data/Supplementary table - patchDE results.csv"))

# ID noteworthy genes:
eps <- 0.5
crit <- (abs(ests) > eps) & (ps < 0.01)
critdir <- 1*((ests > eps) & (ps < 0.01)) - 1*((ests < -eps) & (ps < 0.01))
list1 <- names(which(rowSums(crit) >= 3))
```

Now let's explore our results:

```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}

# how widespread were the hits?
sum(rowSums(ps[list1, ] < 0.01) < 0.5*ncol(ps))
sum(rowSums(ps[list1, ] < 0.01) < 0.1*ncol(ps))
hist(rowMeans(ps[list1, ] < 0.01))


# cluster the genes:
cormat <- cor(t(ests[list1, ]))

p1 <- pheatmap::pheatmap((ests * (ps < 0.05))[list1, ], 
               breaks = seq(-1,1,length.out=101),
               fontsize_row = 8, show_colnames = F,
               cutree_rows = 10,
               clustering_distance_rows = "correlation",
               border_color = NA,
               color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "grey90", "red"))(100))

cuts <- cutree(p1$tree_row, k = 10)

svg(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Plots/patchDE heatmap by tiny bin.svg"), height = 5.5, width = 4.5)
print(p1)
dev.off()
#png("results/patchDE heatmap by tiny bin - tall.svg", height = 8, width = 3.5, units = "in", res = 400)\
svg(paste0(prolif_dir, "/Plots/patchDE heatmap by tiny bin - tall.svg"), height = 10, width = 3.5)
print(p1)
dev.off()
```


```{r echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE, out.width = "85%"}

```

```{r echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE}
# make metagenes:
unique_cuts <- unique(cuts)
result_list <- vector("list", length(unique_cuts))
names(result_list) <- unique_cuts
for (i in seq_along(unique_cuts)) {
  cutnum <- unique_cuts[i]
  tempgenes <- names(cuts)[cuts == cutnum]
  result_list[[i]] <- Matrix::rowMeans(norm.s[, tempgenes, drop = FALSE])
}

mscores <- do.call(cbind, result_list)
colnames(mscores) <- unique_cuts
for (i in 1:ncol(mscores)) {
  colnames(mscores)[i] <- substr(paste0(names(cuts[cuts == i]), collapse = "_"), 1, 20)
}

# how often is the major metagene significant?
genes <- names(cuts)[cuts == 2]
rowMeans(ps[genes, ] < 1e-2)

## customized plots for 2 selected metagenes:
```
